title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first weeks in the UBC Master of Data Science program have been both challenging and exciting. I have been learning how to use tools such as Git, GitHub, Bash, VS Code, and Quarto while also adapting to the pace of the program.
One of the biggest changes for me has been becoming more comfortable with programming and command-line tools. At first, some of the workflows felt unfamiliar, but after working through several labs and assignments, I have started to understand how the different tools work together.
I am looking forward to developing stronger skills in programming, statistics, and data analysis throughout the MDS program. I also hope to apply these skills to areas that interest me, including finance, artificial intelligence, and real-world data problems.



UBC campus during my first weeks in MDS.

title: Exploring Palmer Penguins with Python
text:
Summary by species
The following table compares the average body mass and flipper length across the three penguin species.

species_summary = (
    penguins.groupby("species")
    .agg(
        mean_body_mass_g=("body_mass_g", "mean"),
        mean_flipper_length_mm=("flipper_length_mm", "mean")
    )
    .round(1)
)

title: Exploring Palmer Penguins with Python
text:
Flipper length and body mass
The scatter plot below shows the relationship between flipper length and body mass.

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

for species, group in penguins.groupby("species"):
    plt.scatter(
        group["flipper_length_mm"],
        group["body_mass_g"],
        label=species,
        alpha=0.7
    )

plt.xlabel("Flipper length (mm)")
plt.ylabel("Body mass (g)")
plt.title("Body mass vs. flipper length by species")
plt.legend()
plt.show()

title: Exploring Palmer Penguins with R
text:
Summary by species
The following table compares the average body mass and flipper length across the three penguin species.

species_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    mean_body_mass_g = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_flipper_length_mm = mean(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

title: Exploring Palmer Penguins with R
text:
Flipper length and body mass
The scatter plot below shows the relationship between flipper length and body mass for each penguin species.

ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(
    x = flipper_length_mm,
    y = body_mass_g,
    color = species
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Body mass vs. flipper length by species",
    x = "Flipper length (mm)",
    y = "Body mass (g)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
